description: Unofficial Otomachi Una fan-art companion in a simplified dark-blue and yellow costume, fixed eel hat and paired three-section purple braids. Original choreography includes arranging translucent paper circles, a gentle braid-swinging side step, paper recovery, foam-baton waiting, paper-strip rolling, articulated directional runs and a small hop. Nine independently drawn states with modest clothing and simplified details.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
